about: Human checklist for a generated workspace in live Revit. Set each status to pass, fail, warn, skip, or not_run. Only id, required, and status are recorded; 'step' text and your notes are never copied into evidence. Do not remove checks or change 'required'.

checks.step: With Revit open and no document loaded, click pyRevit > Reload. The reload finishes with no error in the pyRevit output window mentioning the workspace extension.
The profile's tab (BIMxBert for the default profile) appears with its sample panel (Foundation) containing Hello Button.
With Revit's light UI theme, the Hello Button icon is crisp at the large size and uses the profile's dark outline with accent dots.
Switch Revit to the dark UI theme (Options > Colors > Active theme), reload if needed: the light-outline icon.dark.png variant is shown instead.
Hovering shows the tooltip text; pressing F1 while hovering (or the help link) opens the profile's support URL.
With no document open, click Hello Button: it exits quietly with the 'requires an open Revit project document' message and no dialog error.
With a family document active, click Hello Button: an alert says a project document is required, then the tool exits.
With a project document active, click Hello Button: the dialog shows the project title, active view, and a non-template view count.
After the project run, the Undo list contains no Hello Button entry and Revit does not prompt to save changes made by the tool.

Click UI Kit Demo (same panel). A chooser dialog opens with the firm's titlebar, symbol mark, and usage badge; the profile's fonts render (for BIMxBert: condensed headings, Geist body). Esc closes it without an error.
Run UI Kit Demo again and continue: the view selector lists view names, typing filters the list, the primary button stays disabled until something is selected, and Enter accepts.
After selecting, the result dialog shows the status heading, summary, and log; Copy log works; Close returns to Revit; the Undo list gains no UI Kit Demo entry.
Close Revit normally. No pyRevit or extension error appears during shutdown.
Optional: render the Quillmoor workspace, register it too, reload, and confirm a separate Quillmoor tab appears without disturbing the first.
